methodologyNotes: Roster covers 11 benchtop and floor-standing drill presses spanning entry-level to professional tiers, including all models in the brief plus the current Skil successor (DP9505-00) in place of the discontinued 3320-01. Specs and prices were independently re-verified against manufacturer product pages (WEN, Powermatic, Skil, Craftsman, JET Tools, Delta Machinery), authorized-dealer pages (Woodcraft, Rockler, Factory Authorized Outlet, Northern Tool, WoodArt Supply), and independent reviews (Pro Tool Reviews, Concord Carpenter, Home Construction Improvement). swing_in is the industry-standard swing figure (twice the column-to-spindle distance, i.e. the swing-over-table diameter), NOT the marketing model number; laser_guide is a boolean (true = included in the box); speed_range_rpm reports the stated published min and max RPM as a string; motor_hp uses the manufacturer's published HP figure where available and null where only amperage is published. Two corrections from the draft: Delta 18-900L price (the draft's $1,499 was the stale 2020 launch MSRP; current SRP is ~$829 per Pro Tool Reviews 2025, corroborated by retailer sale prices, though dealer lists run higher) and Craftsman CMXEDAX69434601 swing (the '10-inch' is a marketing model name; actual swing distance is 8 in. per Craftsman spec sheet and 6+ retailer listings). accessedAt 2026-06-20.

products.name: Shop Fox W1668 13-1/4-Inch Oscillating Benchtop Drill Press
products.priceNote: Typical dealer price (Factory Authorized Outlet / PMC ~$775); Home Depot listed ~$640, Northern Tool ~$860
